# Public release checklist

- [x] Confirm final name and repository slug.
- [x] Search project/package registries and relevant scholarly indexes for name collisions.
- [ ] Confirm maintainers, authorship order and ORCID identifiers.
- [x] Select and add an explicit software/documentation license (MIT).
- [x] Add and syntactically validate `CITATION.cff`.
- [x] Declare repository URL and public security contact.
- [x] Run the conformance suite in clean Python environments.
- [x] Publish a compatibility matrix for tested model/backend combinations.
- [x] Document installation, supported Python versions and migration policy.
- [ ] Tag a SemVer release and archive the exact version in a persistent repository.
- [ ] Record the version DOI in citation metadata.
- [x] Audit the README for FAIR4RS, privacy, methodology and model-portability overclaims.
